question: What Are the Types of Allen Bradley PLC?
body_html:
Allen Bradley PLC types are families sized for different automation levels: MicroLogix, CompactLogix and ControlLogix, all from Rockwell Automation.

FamilyDesignSoftwareTypical use
MicroLogixCompact brick, fixed I/ORSLogix 500Small machines, legacy panels
CompactLogixModular, expandable I/O, native EtherNet/IPStudio 5000Packaging lines, skids, OEM machines
ControlLogixRack based, redundancy, thousands of I/OStudio 5000Oil and gas, power, chemical plants
